title: Sordland/Turn08/A_AschrafAnniversary
description: Visit to the Aschraf Anniversary. Experience the Bludish societal pulse.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The city had been of particular imp..."
entries.dialogueText: The city had been of particular importance to the Bludish people ever since the Izzam Incident and the death of Watani Aschraf over two decades ago. Today, we were here to commemorate the anniversary of those events.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our massive convoy could barely fit..."
entries.dialogueText: Our massive convoy could barely fit through the narrow streets, disrupting local traffic and creating noisy chaos in the usually tranquil city. Pedestrians stared at us in fear as we and our heavily armed security forces drove towards the square.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our convoy could barely fit through..."
entries.dialogueText: Our convoy could barely fit through the narrow streets, disrupting local traffic and creating noisy chaos in the usually tranquil city. Pedestrians stared at us with concern as we and our security forces drove towards the square.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I hope so.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I hope so.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I must say this was a good decisio..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must say this was a good decision, sir. This will help ease the tensions. But I hope bringing this much security won't cause any problems.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Better safe than sorry.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Better safe than sorry.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That was my intention all along.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That was my intention all along.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I agree.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I agree.”

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“Welcome to Erzaren, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: “Welcome to Erzaren, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It is certainly risky. But if we m..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is certainly risky. But if we manage to win some hearts today, it will be worth it.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“If we play our cards right, I am c..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we play our cards right, I am certain.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“As expected.”"
entries.dialogueText: “As expected.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We are almost there. I can hear th..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are almost there. I can hear the crowd.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“They are telling us to go back whe..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are telling us to go back where we came from.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard the chants and shouting fro..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard the chants and shouting from outside. Lucian leaned closer to the window, listening to their voices.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard the chants and shouting fro..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard the chants and shouting from the outside. Lucian leaned closer to the window, listening to their voices.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“They seem to be chanting 'Yollak B..."
entries.dialogueText: “They seem to be chanting 'Yollak Bluderat'. I believe that means 'Free Bludia' in Bludish, or something of that sort.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A large crowd had assembled in the..."
entries.dialogueText: A large crowd had assembled in the square. There were probably at least ten thousand people. Most of them were yelling insults and obscenities at me. I heard a few shouts of "Soll's boot licker!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A large crowd had assembled in the..."
entries.dialogueText: A large crowd had assembled in the square. There were probably at least ten thousand people.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As our convoy slowed down, a young..."
entries.dialogueText: As our convoy slowed down, a young Bludish man ran in front of our vehicle and spat on my window.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Mr. Leke.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Leke.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our vehicle came to a stop."
entries.dialogueText: Our vehicle came to a stop.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The security detail left their vehi..."
entries.dialogueText: The security detail left their vehicles with their machine guns openly displayed. I followed them. The crowd seemed to be riled up at the sight of guns.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My driver exited the vehicle and op..."
entries.dialogueText: My driver exited the vehicle and opened the door for me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were greeted by Mansoun Leke. He..."
entries.dialogueText: We were greeted by Mansoun Leke. He wore a coat over his suit which was marked with the red and turquoise stripes of the Bludish movement's flag. He moved forward to greet us.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No need for pleasantries. I want t..."
entries.dialogueText: “No need for pleasantries. I want this over with as quickly as possible.”
entries.menuText: “No need for pleasantries. I want this over with as quickly as possible.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It looks like I am not welcome her..."
entries.dialogueText: “It looks like I am not welcome here, Mr. Leke.”
entries.menuText: “It looks like I am not welcome here, Mr. Leke.”

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“Very perceptive of you. But that i..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very perceptive of you. But that is why you are here, if I am correct. To fix this.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pointed at the security guards w..."
entries.dialogueText: He pointed at the security guards with guns.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“I am not sure how bringing your pe..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am not sure how bringing your personal army will help.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They are here for protection.”"
entries.dialogueText: “They are here for protection.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They are not my personal army. The..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are not my personal army. They protect the government.”
entries.menuText: “They are not my personal army. They protect the government.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's *go*.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's *go*.”

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“Protection from your own citizens?..."
entries.dialogueText: “Protection from your own citizens? I guess there must be a reason to be fearful.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We shook hands."
entries.dialogueText: We shook hands.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I held our clasped hands up so that..."
entries.dialogueText: I held our clasped hands up so that the crowd could see them.
entries.menuText: Take his hand and raise it in a display of unity.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard shouts in Bludish coming fr..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard shouts in Bludish coming from the crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard some applause from the crow..."
entries.dialogueText: I heard some applause from the crowd.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“I see. The government must have a..."
entries.dialogueText: “I see. The government must have a reason to fear its own citizens then.”

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“On a day like this, when you want..."
entries.dialogueText: “On a day like this, when you want to show support for the murdered Bludish people... You bring men with guns.”

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“Mr. Galade. Welcome. Shall we move..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Galade. Welcome. Shall we move on to the Sanctuary, then?”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Let's go.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's go.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We made our way to the Erzaren Sanc..."
entries.dialogueText: We made our way to the Erzaren Sanctuary, which stood at the end of the square.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A much smaller replica of the Archs..."
entries.dialogueText: A much smaller replica of the Archsanctuary in Deyr, the ancient building had a mystical aura emanting from its blackened walls. We entered the building through the ornamented large metal gates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we walked, the noise of the crow..."
entries.dialogueText: As we walked, the noise of the crowd faded out. Everyone fell silent for the ceremony. Thousands of candles were burning inside the Sanctuary, one for each person that died in Izzam. The red candle in the center was for Watani Aschraf.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun gestured towards the candle..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun gestured towards the candles.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I picked up one of the candles."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up one of the candles.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I picked up the red candle for Wata..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the red candle for Watani Aschraf.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did not pick a candle. Instead, I..."
entries.dialogueText: I did not pick a candle. Instead, I let Mansoun lead the way. His face soured.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He also picked up a candle and star..."
entries.dialogueText: He also picked up a candle and started walking out. Many others followed suit, including us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He picked up the candle for Aschraf..."
entries.dialogueText: He picked up the candle for Aschraf and started walking out. Many others followed suit, including us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He picked up the candle for Aschraf..."
entries.dialogueText: He picked up the candle for Aschraf and started walking out. Many others followed suit, including us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The atmosphere outside had complete..."
entries.dialogueText: The atmosphere outside had completely changed. Not a single noise came from the crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We slowly walked towards Aschraf's..."
entries.dialogueText: We slowly walked towards Aschraf's grave. On the way, hundreds of people joined us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Seeing the red candle in my hand, s..."
entries.dialogueText: Seeing the red candle in my hand, some people started shouting at me, breaking the silence. One man managed to break the security cordon and ran towards me, screaming.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When we arrived, he pointed at a hu..."
entries.dialogueText: When we arrived, he pointed at a huge standing torch above the grave.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When we arrived, Mansoun lit the un..."
entries.dialogueText: When we arrived, Mansoun lit the unlit candle above the grave.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I lit the torch."
entries.dialogueText: I lit the torch.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We lit the torch together."
entries.dialogueText: We lit the torch together.
entries.menuText: Light the torch together with Mansoun.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned around and realized the sh..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned around and realized the sheer amount of people who were following us. They were all looking at me, waiting to hear what I would say.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My fellow citizens.”"
entries.dialogueText: “My fellow citizens.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Brothers and sisters.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Brothers and sisters.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are here to mourn Watani Aschra..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are here to mourn Watani Aschraf and many others who have lost their lives.”
entries.menuText: “We are here to mourn Watani Aschraf and many others who have lost their lives.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Free people of Bludia.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Free people of Bludia.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let me tell you one thing. I dream..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let me tell you one thing. I dream of a truly united Sordland. A country where being a Blud or a Sord does not matter.”
entries.menuText: “Let me tell you one thing. I dream of a truly united Sordland. A country where being a Blud or a Sord does not matter.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I signalled the security guards to..."
entries.dialogueText: I signalled the security guards to detain him. They immediately ran out and the boy disappeared from my sight. Another guard came over to wipe the car window.
entries.menuText: Signal the security to detain him.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did not do anything."
entries.dialogueText: I did not do anything.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Seeing the boy get dragged away cau..."
entries.dialogueText: Seeing the boy get dragged away caused an outcry from the crowd. Hundreds of people rushed at our car.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They were brave men and women who..."
entries.dialogueText: “They were brave men and women who only wanted to protect their land.”
entries.menuText: “They were brave men and women who only wanted to protect their land.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am not standing before you today..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am not standing before you today as the President. I am standing here as one of you.”
entries.menuText: “I am not standing before you today as the President. I am standing here as one of you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I condemn the events that led to t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I condemn the events that led to the loss of these lives.”
entries.menuText: “I condemn the events that led to the loss of these lives.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I share your hatred and anger. I f..."
entries.dialogueText: “I share your hatred and anger. I feel it too, I assure you. Like a red-hot iron, it takes a long time for it to cool. But I look at the lost lives and think, what would they want?”
entries.menuText: “I share your hatred and anger. I feel it too, I assure you. Like a red-hot iron, it takes a long time for it to cool. But I look at the lost lives and think, what would they want?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I assure you, this administration..."
entries.dialogueText: “I assure you, this administration will do its absolute best to mend the wounds.”
entries.menuText: “I assure you, this administration will do its absolute best to mend the wounds.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Despite attempts to divide us, our..."
entries.dialogueText: “Despite attempts to divide us, our people will stand as one. We are Sord. We are Blud. We are all united under one flag.”
entries.menuText: “Despite attempts to divide us, our people will stand as one. We are Sord. We are Blud. We are all united under one flag.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are all the same before God. Re..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are all the same before God. Remember the words: 'Love thy brothers and thy sisters.'”
entries.menuText: “We are all the same before God. Remember the words: 'Love thy brothers and thy sisters.'”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let this be a testament of our uni..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let this be a testament of our unity for future generations! Let's stand together as Blud and Sord.”
entries.menuText: “Let this be a testament of our unity for future generations! Let's stand together as Blud and Sord.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I feel responsible and ashamed for..."
entries.dialogueText: “I feel responsible and ashamed for the actions of my predecessors. Most of all, I feel the desperation to remove this black mark from our history.”
entries.menuText: “I feel responsible and ashamed for the actions of my predecessors. Most of all, I feel the desperation to remove this black mark from our history.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We must always stay together in th..."
entries.dialogueText: “We must always stay together in the face of adversity. Against all odds.”
entries.menuText: “We must always stay together in the face of adversity. Against all odds.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Mistakes were made. The innocent p..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mistakes were made. The innocent people of Izzam paid the price. But we cannot let the past divide us.”
entries.menuText: “Mistakes were made. The innocent people of Izzam paid the price. But we cannot let the past divide us.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I need help from each and every on..."
entries.dialogueText: “I need help from each and every one of you. To make this country a better place for everyone.”
entries.menuText: “I need help from each and every one of you. To make this country a better place for everyone.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The responsibility falls on all of..."
entries.dialogueText: “The responsibility falls on all of our shoulders. Because we don't have anyone but each other.”
entries.menuText: “The responsibility falls on all of our shoulders. Because we don't have anyone but each other.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yollak Bluderat!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yollak Bluderat!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Morning will come!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Morning will come!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was no reaction from the crow..."
entries.dialogueText: There was no reaction from the crowd. Only silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An old man from the crowd yelled: "..."
entries.dialogueText: An old man from the crowd yelled: "Your flag! Your nation!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An old man from the crowd yelled: "..."
entries.dialogueText: An old man from the crowd yelled: "Revenge!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An old man from the crowd yelled: "..."
entries.dialogueText: An old man from the crowd yelled: "Bullshit!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't play into the hands of the s..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't play into the hands of the separationists. United we stand. Divided we fall.”
entries.menuText: “Don't play into the hands of the separationists. United we stand. Divided we fall.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I paid no attention."
entries.dialogueText: I paid no attention.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“To what end? We need to break this..."
entries.dialogueText: “To what end? We need to break this vicious cycle of violence and vengeance for a better future.”
entries.menuText: “To what end? We need to break this vicious cycle of violence and vengeance for a better future.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I paid no attention."
entries.dialogueText: I paid no attention.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I paid no attention."
entries.dialogueText: I paid no attention.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Despite these kinds of attempts to..."
entries.dialogueText: “Despite these kinds of attempts to divide us, we will be united as one. We will work together!”
entries.menuText: “Despite these kinds of attempts to divide us, we will be united as one. We will work together!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let me finish.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let me finish.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An old man from the crowd yelled: "..."
entries.dialogueText: An old man from the crowd yelled: "He is right!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An old man from the crowd yelled: "..."
entries.dialogueText: An old man from the crowd yelled: "He is right!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An old man from the crowd yelled: "..."
entries.dialogueText: An old man from the crowd yelled: "He speaks the truth!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let me finish.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let me finish.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let me finish.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let me finish.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are you with me?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Are you with me?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun leaned in closer to me."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun leaned in closer to me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked at me worriedly. Peop..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked at me worriedly. People started coming closer and closer to us, chanting "Yollak Bluderat."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was immediately surrounded by the..."
entries.dialogueText: I was immediately surrounded by the security detail I had brought with me. They had drawn their guns and were pointing them at the approaching crowd.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We must leave, sir. Now!”"
entries.dialogueText: “We must leave, sir. Now!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was the deafening noise of ma..."
entries.dialogueText: There was the deafening noise of machine gun fire. I closed my eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everything became a blur. The guard..."
entries.dialogueText: Everything became a blur. The guards circled around me, shielding me from the chaos.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They escorted me to our vehicle in..."
entries.dialogueText: They escorted me to our vehicle in a matter of seconds. I heard more gunshots as we drove out of Erzaren.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“I must admit, Mr. President. That..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must admit, Mr. President. That was a good speech.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Just doing my duty.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Just doing my duty.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I hope the crowd thinks the same.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I hope the crowd thinks the same.”
entries.menuText: “I hope the crowd thinks the same.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He extended his hand to me for a ha..."
entries.dialogueText: He extended his hand to me for a handshake.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "As we shook hands, the crowd starte..."
entries.dialogueText: As we shook hands, the crowd started to clap.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Instead of going for the handshake,..."
entries.dialogueText: Instead of going for the handshake, I spread my arms and hugged him. Suddenly, the whole crowd erupted in applause.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“Thank you for this, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for this, Mr. President. I don't think the people of Erzaren will ever forget this.”

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“You have become the first and only..."
entries.dialogueText: “You have become the first and only president brave enough to come to Erzaren and pay respects to the Izzam victims. I hope this will be the start of a new era.”

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Sir, it's time to go.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sir, it's time to go.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We started making our way back to t..."
entries.dialogueText: We started making our way back to the convoy.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Well done, sir. This will prove ve..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well done, sir. This will prove very useful in the upcoming elections.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What's the rush?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What's the rush?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Exactly my plan.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Exactly my plan.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Time will tell.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Time will tell.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian bowed his head."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian bowed his head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered our vehicles and started..."
entries.dialogueText: We entered our vehicles and started making our way back home from Erzaren.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian grabbed my shoulder."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian grabbed my shoulder.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“We must leave. Now!”"
entries.dialogueText: “We must leave. Now!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With only our personal guards prote..."
entries.dialogueText: With only our personal guards protecting us against a crowd of thousands, we starting making our way back to the cars hastily.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The convoy started driving away as..."
entries.dialogueText: The convoy started driving away as soon as we were seated. The windows of the vehicles were completely covered with rotten vegetables, eggs and splatters of paint by the time we finally left the city.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I must say this was a good decisio..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must say this was a good decision, sir. This will help ease tensions.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes. But I am still worried about..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. But I am still worried about our safety.”
entries.menuText: “Yes. But I am still worried about our safety.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered the historic center wear..."
entries.dialogueText: We entered the historic center wearing flak vests, transported by an armored personnel carrier. I gazed out its windows at the city's rundown buildings.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was an outcry from the crowd...."
entries.dialogueText: There was an outcry from the crowd. Hundreds of people shouted slurs at us while keeping their distance. The heavy weaponry that the security carried seemed to have startled them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The ceremonies were to be held in t..."
entries.dialogueText: The ceremonies were to be held in the aptly named Izzam Square, several blocks away from Lake Soll and the sunken ruins of the village of Izzam.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered the historic center in t..."
entries.dialogueText: We entered the historic center in the presidential Kadilla. The streets were littered with broken glass and the walls defaced with graffiti. I sensed a heavy regional police presence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The local police forces did their b..."
entries.dialogueText: The local police forces did their best to calm the angry crowd and pushed them away from our vehicle. I suddenly had the feeling that our forces were in danger of being overwhelmed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a few hours' drive, we finall..."
entries.dialogueText: After a few hours' drive, we finally arrived in the ancient walled city of Erzaren.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“They seem to be chanting your name..."
entries.dialogueText: “They seem to be chanting your name, sir. I believe they are happy with their new autonomy.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd before me had signs in th..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd before me had signs in their hands protesting my decision to centralize Bergia.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“Very perceptive of you. I wonder w..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very perceptive of you. I wonder why that is the case...”

entries.title: Narrator: "Someone from the crowd shouted at m..."
entries.dialogueText: Someone from the crowd shouted at me, breaking the silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I noticed an excessively high amoun..."
entries.dialogueText: I noticed an excessively high amount of regional police, as well as the gendarmerie and local police. They formed a human barricade around the square, staring intimidatingly at the crowd.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Must be the governor's doing.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Must be the governor's doing.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some people started shouting at me,..."
entries.dialogueText: Some people started shouting at me, breaking the silence. One man managed to break the security cordon and ran towards me, screaming.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Noticing I had no candle in my hand..."
entries.dialogueText: Noticing I had no candle in my hand, someone in the crowd shouted at me, breaking the silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I could react, security forc..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I could react, security forces grabbed the man and dragged him away.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I ignored the man and kept walking."
entries.dialogueText: I ignored the man and kept walking.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Before I finished my gesture, secur..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I finished my gesture, security forces grabbed the man and dragged him away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun looked at me with a mix of..."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun looked at me with a mix of fear and anger in his eyes, but he knew better than to speak.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered the historic center wear..."
entries.dialogueText: We entered the historic center wearing flak vests, transported by an armored personnel carrier. The streets were littered with broken glass and the walls defaced with graffiti. I sensed a heavy regional police presence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered the historic center in t..."
entries.dialogueText: We entered the historic center in the presidential Kadilla. I gazed out its windows at the city's rundown buildings.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I must say this was a good decisio..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must say this was a good decision, sir. After giving the Bludish autonomy, this will send a strong message that you are on their side. But I hope bringing this much security won't cause any problems.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“I must say this was a good decisio..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must say this was a good decision, sir. After giving the Bludish autonomy, this will send a strong message that you are on their side.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A large crowd had assembled in the..."
entries.dialogueText: A large crowd had assembled in the square. There were probably at least ten thousand people. Most of them were yelling insults and obscenities at me.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“I suppose the governor's huge army..."
entries.dialogueText: “I suppose the governor's huge army wasn't enough. Bergia has already become a police state. A truly *special* zone.”

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“I don't know what your intention i..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't know what your intention is, but I only ask of you to at least be respectful during the ceremony, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pointed at the gendarmerie force..."
entries.dialogueText: He pointed at the gendarmerie forces.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“I am not sure how bringing your ar..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am not sure how bringing your army will help.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's the governor's doing.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's the governor's doing.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They are not my army. They protect..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are not my army. They protect the Special Region of Bergia.”
entries.menuText: “They are not my army. They protect the Special Region of Bergia.”

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“The man who abuses his authority t..."
entries.dialogueText: “The man who abuses his authority to oppress Bergia.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's just move on, Mr. Leke.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's just move on, Mr. Leke.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I am supportive of you, Mr. Leke...."
entries.dialogueText: “I am supportive of you, Mr. Leke. I want him gone as much as you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are trying our best to contain..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are trying our best to contain him, but without changing the laws there's nothing I can do about it.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He clenched his jaw."
entries.dialogueText: He clenched his jaw.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My only intention is to stand in s..."
entries.dialogueText: “My only intention is to stand in solidarity with our Bludish people.”
entries.menuText: “My only intention is to stand in solidarity with our Bludish people.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's just move on, Mr. Leke.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's just move on, Mr. Leke.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Watch your words. You are speaking..."
entries.dialogueText: “Watch your words. You are speaking to the president.”
entries.menuText: “Watch your words. You are speaking to the president.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: He raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I put the candle next to the torch."
entries.dialogueText: I put the candle next to the torch.
entries.menuText: Leave the candle next to it.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are here to mourn those who, tr..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are here to mourn those who, tragically, lost their lives in Izzam.”
entries.menuText: “We are here to mourn those who, tragically, lost their lives in Izzam.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“To our unity!”"
entries.dialogueText: “To our unity!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One man broke the silence and shout..."
entries.dialogueText: One man broke the silence and shouted "Do not listen to murderers!", and threw a tomato. It hit the ground right in front of me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian rushed over to me."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian rushed over to me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Not everything is about votes.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Not everything is about votes.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“It's not?”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's not?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Despite ultranationalists, we keep..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite ultranationalists, we keep marching!" shouted a group of people in the very front, who also started waving the flags of the Workers Party of Bludia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""You cannot claim that you support..."
entries.dialogueText: "You cannot claim that you support us after trying to kill our language!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""What were you doing in Wehlen agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "What were you doing in Wehlen against our people? You are responsible of the deaths of thousands!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""You supported Murderer Smolak in h..."
entries.dialogueText: "You supported Murderer Smolak in his crusade against our people! You denied entry to innocent refugees! You are responsible for the deaths of thousands!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a moment of complete sile..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a moment of complete silence. Then, the whole crowd erupted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was immediately surrounded by the..."
entries.dialogueText: I was immediately surrounded by the local police forces. They had drawn their guns and were pointing them at the approaching crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hearing the chaos, regional police..."
entries.dialogueText: Hearing the chaos, regional police forces and the gendarmerie also rushed to our aid. Suddenly, the entire crowd was surrounded by an army.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the security forces pushed every..."
entries.dialogueText: As the security forces pushed everyone away, the presidential guard escorted us back to our vehicle.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Sir, I think we must leave.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sir, I think we must leave.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“That was close.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That was close.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm glad I brought this much secur..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm glad I brought this much security.”
entries.menuText: “I'm glad I brought this much security.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They will pay for this.”"
entries.dialogueText: “They will pay for this.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We should have been more careful.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We should have been more careful.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered our vehicles and startin..."
entries.dialogueText: We entered our vehicles and starting making our way back home from Erzaren.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to follow him. Just then,..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to follow him. Just then, someone yelled "Yollak Bluderat" and dashed towards us with a knife.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The noise stopped. I gathered up th..."
entries.dialogueText: The noise stopped. I gathered up the courage to open my eyes again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The man had fallen to the ground. T..."
entries.dialogueText: The man had fallen to the ground. The crowd panicked and began to scatter.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at the crowd."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at the crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A woman, probably his mother, fell..."
entries.dialogueText: A woman, probably his mother, fell on her knees right next to him and caressed his head. Her scream pierced the panic.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“Thank you, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“I don't know if any of this really..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't know if any of this really makes a difference after what you have done against the Bludish people.”

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: "“Still, you came here to Erzaren fo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Still, you came here to Erzaren for the anniversary of the Izzam Incident. That is a good start.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“The whole trip runs on a schedule,..."
entries.dialogueText: “The whole trip runs on a schedule, sir. The convoy needs to start driving now, or else we won't make it back in time.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw another body on the ground be..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw another body on the ground behind him. It was a boy.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That boy! Make sure he is okay!”"
entries.dialogueText: “That boy! Make sure he is okay!”
entries.menuText: “That boy! Make sure he is okay!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My God.”"
entries.dialogueText: “My God.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Get an ambulance now!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Get an ambulance now!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We have to get out of here.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We have to get out of here.”
entries.menuText: “We have to get out of here.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On our way to Erzaren, we stopped i..."
entries.dialogueText: On our way to Erzaren, we stopped in Deyr to meet with the Governor of Bergia, Phelix Bron, to discuss the security situation within the Special Zone. He wished us luck at the event and told us to be careful before bidding us farewell.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On our way to Erzaren, we stopped i..."
entries.dialogueText: On our way to Erzaren, we stopped in Deyr to meet with the Governor of Bergia, Herbert Krull, to discuss the security situation within the Special Zone. He wished us luck at the event and told us to be extremely careful before bidding us farewell.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On our way to Erzaren, we stopped i..."
entries.dialogueText: On our way to Erzaren, we stopped in Deyr to meet with the new Governor of Bergia, Ishval Ersen, to discuss the implementation of the autonomous zone. He welcomed us with great sympathy and care, and wished us the best for the event.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On our way to inner Erzaren, we sto..."
entries.dialogueText: On our way to inner Erzaren, we stopped to meet with the local police chief, Ionas Fisser, to discuss how the abolishment of the Zone was faring for the locals.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw many signs that condemned the..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw many signs that condemned the arrest of Fetih Ejall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw many signs that condemned the..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw many signs that condemned the ban on the Workers' Party of Bludia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just then, I noticed a few BFF flag..."
entries.dialogueText: Just then, I noticed a few BFF flags waving at the very back of the crowd.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I signalled to Lucian. He immediate..."
entries.dialogueText: I signalled to Lucian. He immediately bowed his head towards mine so I could whisper in his ear.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I ignored them and started my speec..."
entries.dialogueText: I ignored them and started my speech.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Is there something wrong, sir?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is there something wrong, sir?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There are people in the crowd with..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are people in the crowd with BFF flags. I thought security wouldn't allow such a thing."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not sure if I should continue..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sure if I should continue with the speech, Lucian. I think we might be in danger."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I saw some BFF flags. Could you pl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I saw some BFF flags. Could you please check if everything's all right?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Are you sure, sir? The police woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure, sir? The police wouldn't have allowed those flags here."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Are you sure, sir? I can't see any..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure, sir? I can't see anything. The police wouldn't have allowed those flags here."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Do you want to cancel the speech,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you want to cancel the speech, sir?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd was getting restless."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd was getting restless.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Okay, never mind. I'll continue wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Okay, never mind. I'll continue with the speech."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. I want to cancel the speech...."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I want to cancel the speech. Let's leave this place immediately."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Good luck, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course, sir. Please follow me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir. Please follow me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We quickly made our way offstage am..."
entries.dialogueText: We quickly made our way offstage amid surprised looks from the crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A man shouted, "Yes! Run away to yo..."
entries.dialogueText: A man shouted, "Yes! Run away to your home! Don't ever come back here!" and threw a tomato. It hit the ground right in front of me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked at me worriedly. Peop..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked at me worriedly. People started walking closer and closer to us, chanting "Yollak Bluderat."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a second of silence. Then..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a second of silence. Then, the entire crowd erupted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Despite ultranationalists, we keep..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite ultranationalists, we keep marching!" shouted a group of people in the very front, wielding the flags of the Workers Party of Bludia.
